steps.description: Build a DESeqDataSet from the raw integer counts and metadata. Pre-filter minimally: keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least as many samples as the smallest group holds (6 here). Set the condition reference level explicitly to control with relevel, so a positive log2 fold change means higher in treated. Fit design = ~ condition ONLY. Do not add a batch term (the model matrix would be rank-deficient) and do not apply ComBat-seq, removeBatchEffect, sva or RUV to the counts — a removal method would strip the condition effect along with the batch. Do not pre-normalize the counts; DESeq2's median-of-ratios size factors enter the model as offsets. Run the Wald test for contrast c('condition','treated','control'), extract results with alpha=0.05 and independent filtering on, and shrink the log2 fold change with apeglm on the treated_vs_control coefficient, keeping the unshrunken estimate alongside in the table. Additionally run a second results call with lfcThreshold=1 to test against a two-fold effect inside the model, and report how many genes pass that at padj<0.05 — do not derive this by post-hoc filtering the estimates. Report separately the number of genes with NA p-values from the Cook's-distance outlier flag (with 6 replicates per cell DESeq2 flags rather than replaces) and the number removed by independent filtering. Write a full results table (gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange raw and shrunken, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj) plus MA and volcano plots. Every artifact this step writes must carry a header line stating that treatment is perfectly confounded with processing batch and that the estimates are treatment-plus-batch, not treatment.

caveats: Any enriched pathway may reflect the B1-vs-B2 processing difference rather than treatment.

grounding.reason: Preranked fgsea on the full tested-gene list against human hallmark sets, size window 15-500, tested genes as universe, redundant sets collapsed; for the disputed R-0007 ranking metric the Wald statistic side is chosen and stated.

constraints: Use the FULL ranked list of tested genes; never cut the list at padj or fold change before the test.
Universe = the genes tested in T1S2, not the whole genome or annotation.
Gene set size window 15-500 applied AFTER intersecting each set with the tested genes.
The organism must be human; do not use a mouse collection.
Name the ranking metric (Wald statistic) and the reason for the choice in the output.
If no suitable human gene set collection is present in the environment, report that and emit the ranked list; do not invent gene sets.
Label all enrichment output as derived from a batch-confounded contrast.
steps.description: Rank every tested gene (the full filtered list from T1S2, not a thresholded subset) by the DESeq2 Wald statistic and run preranked fgsea against hallmark gene sets for Homo sapiens. The report names the collection, its version, the ranking metric, the universe size, and the size window.
Redundant significant sets are collapsed to representatives, with the full table kept as a supplement.
Output states that enrichment results are method-dependent and are hypotheses, not findings.

steps.context: Final synthesis for a 12-sample human lung bulk RNA-seq experiment whose central weakness is a perfect batch/condition confound.
steps.question: What can and cannot be concluded about treated versus control lung transcriptomes from a design where batch B1 is exactly the controls and B2 exactly the treated?

grounding.reason: Report names method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested and n DE (R-0041), the two-method overlap (R-0042), enrichment provenance and method-dependence (R-0051, R-0055), and carries the confounded label mandated by the R-0005 flag.

constraints: The confounding statement appears before any gene table.
Report method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, n tested, n DE per contrast and per method, and session info.
Report the enrichment database, its version, the ranking metric, the universe and the size window, and state that enrichment results are method-dependent.
Do not describe any gene or pathway as a confirmed treatment effect.
Name the concrete experimental fix (both conditions in each batch, or bridging replicates) rather than proposing a computational rescue.
steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1. Enrichment provenance fields are present or their absence is explained.

plan.title: Treated vs control lung RNA-seq, batch-confounded DE
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single bulk RNA-seq experiment in human lung: /eval-phase0-with-confounded-batch-n6-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12,000 genes x 12 samples, raw integer salmon counts, first column gene symbol) and /eval-phase0-with-confounded-batch-n6-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (12 rows x 3 columns: sample, condition, batch). The design is 6 treated vs 6 control, and the processing batch is perfectly confounded with the condition — B1 holds all 6 controls, B2 holds all 6 treated. This single fact governs the whole plan: the model matrix ~ batch + condition is not full rank, so no batch term can be fitted, and no correction method (ComBat-seq, limma removeBatchEffect, sva/RUV) may be applied, because any such method removes the condition effect together with the batch. The plan therefore does NOT attempt to separate treatment from batch. It quantifies the treated-vs-control difference under the explicit and untestable assumption of no batch effect, and labels every result as confounded (knowledge rule R-0005@668f, outcome confounded_label_or_stop).

Track 1 runs the statistics. T1S1 does sample-structure QC before any model: library sizes, blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes and a sample-distance heatmap, each coloured by condition and by batch — with the caveat that because the two labels are identical, separation on PC1 is uninterpretable as to cause and the plots serve only to find outliers and gross structure. T1S2 pre-filters minimally (>=10 counts in at least the smallest-group-size samples), fits ~ condition with control set explicitly as the reference level, runs the DESeq2 Wald test for contrast condition treated vs control, shrinks the reported LFC with apeglm, and reports at BH-adjusted p < 0.05 with independent filtering; it also runs an lfcThreshold test for |log2FC| >= 1 inside the model rather than post-hoc filtering, and it counts genes whose p-value is NA from the Cook's-distance outlier flag separately from those the independent filter removed (with 6 per group DESeq2 flags rather than replaces outliers). T1S3 re-runs the same contrast with edgeR quasi-likelihood on the same filtered counts and reports the intersection as the high-confidence set, because two-method overlap is the only robustness check available in a design where the biological contrast cannot be separated from the technical one.

Track 2 interprets. T2S1 runs preranked fgsea on the full ranked list of tested genes using the DESeq2 Wald statistic as the ranking metric (the disputed choice of R-0007@b99a; the Wald statistic is chosen because it is signed and scaled by its own standard error, so it does not over-rank low-count genes with large raw fold changes), against hallmark gene sets for human, size window 15-500 after intersection with the tested genes, BH adjustment, redundant sets collapsed. No reference store is currently provisioned, so this step must resolve human hallmark gene sets from whatever the environment holds at run time and, if none is present, report the absence and emit the ranked gene list as its artifact rather than substituting a different collection or an unversioned hard-coded set. Enrichment is an annotation on the DE result; the research question survives its loss. T2S2 assembles the report: methods, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, number tested, number DE per method and in the intersection, and a mandatory confounding statement placed before the gene tables.

The honest ceiling of this analysis is stated up front and repeated in every step: no analysis of this dataset can distinguish a treatment effect from a B1-vs-B2 processing effect. The gene list is a list of genes that differ between the two processing batches, which also happen to be the two treatment groups. Resolving it requires new data in which each batch contains both conditions, or a technical replicate bridging the batches.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Keep genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (smallest group size)
~ condition only; no batch term and no batch correction because batch is perfectly confounded with condition; reference level control; contrast condition treated vs control
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic with MSigDB Hallmark
Confounded-design report: methods, versions, design, thresholds, n tested, n DE, DESeq2/edgeR overlap, explicit confounding caveat

steps.name: Confounded-design report and interpretation limits
steps.question: What can and cannot be concluded about treated versus control lung transcriptomes from a design where batch B1 is exactly the controls and B2 exactly the treated?
steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1. Lead with the design limitation, before any gene table: processing batch is perfectly confounded with treatment, so every reported difference is a treatment effect plus a batch effect and the two are not separable by any statistical method applied to these 12 samples; correction methods were deliberately not used because they would have removed the condition effect along with the batch. Then report method and package versions, the design formula ~ condition, the contrast (condition, treated, control) with the direction of a positive log2FC, the thresholds (padj<0.05 with independent filtering; the separate lfcThreshold=1 test), the number of genes tested after filtering out of 12,000, the number of DE genes per method and in the DESeq2/edgeR intersection, the NA-p-value accounting, the top up- and down-regulated genes from the high-confidence intersection, the enrichment summary with its database/version/metric/universe/size window, and session info. Close with what would resolve the confounding: samples from each condition processed in each batch, or bridging technical replicates spanning B1 and B2 — not a reanalysis of these data. Do not present any gene as a validated treatment-responsive gene.
steps.context: Final synthesis for a 12-sample human lung bulk RNA-seq experiment whose central weakness is a perfect batch/condition confound.
constraints: The confounding statement appears before any gene table.
Report method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, n tested, n DE per contrast and per method, and session info.
Report the enrichment database, its version, the ranking metric, the universe and the size window, and state that enrichment results are method-dependent.
Do not describe any gene or pathway as a confirmed treatment effect.
Name the concrete experimental fix (both conditions in each batch, or bridging replicates) rather than proposing a computational rescue.
acceptance_criteria: A single report file is produced containing the confounding statement as its first substantive content.
All reporting fields are present: method, versions, design, contrast, thresholds, n tested, n DE, session info.
Enrichment provenance fields are present or their absence is explained.
The limitations section names the experimental design change required and explicitly rules out a computational fix.
caveats: The report must not be written so that a reader skimming the gene table could mistake the list for validated treatment biology.
